email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Communication Officer (Event Coordinator) role at Space Applications Services. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, I have developed strong organisational and communication skills that I believe align well with the requirements of this position.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I manage multiple client websites, coordinate content calendars, and ensure brand consistency across digital channels. I have experience with WordPress, social media platforms, and graphic design tools like Canva, which I understand are valuable for event coordination. While my direct event coordination experience is limited, I am highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with suppliers and budgets. I am eager to apply these skills to plan and execute events that support business development.

I am fluent in English and have a growing proficiency in Dutch, with a strong interest in space and technology. I am confident that my practical, hands-on approach and ability to learn quickly would make me a valuable addition to your communication team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your events.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Communication Officer (Event Coordinator) position at Space Applications Services. Your focus on turning events into concrete business opportunities resonates with my own approach to digital communication: every piece of content, every interaction, should serve a clear purpose. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, I bring a practical, hands-on skill set that I am eager to apply to event coordination.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I manage multiple projects simultaneously, from building WordPress sites to coordinating content for client websites. This has honed my organisational skills and attention to detail—essential for managing event logistics, budgets, and supplier relationships. I regularly work with CMS platforms, social media, and design tools like Canva, which I understand are part of your event toolkit. While my direct experience in trade shows and conferences is limited, I have a strong track record of learning quickly and executing efficiently. I am comfortable working within an existing communication setup and taking direction, as I do with clients and team members.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines my digital communication skills with the opportunity to support business development through well-executed events. I am fluent in English and have a growing proficiency in Dutch, and I am keen to develop my French. My interest in space and technology is a strong motivator, and I am excited about the prospect of contributing to a team that operates in such a dynamic field.

I am proactive, calm under pressure, and solution-oriented—qualities I believe are crucial for on-site event coordination. I am willing to travel regularly and adapt to flexible schedules. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can support your communication team and help make your events a success.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
